proposal.module_text:
---- MODULE ProxyGuard ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Methods, Hosts, FetchSites, OriginKinds, AllowedHostnames
VARIABLES method, host, fetchSite, origin, response

vars == <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, response>>

NoHeader == "absent"

SafeMethods == {"GET", "HEAD", "OPTIONS"}

\* One observation is one call to proxy on a matched /api/ or /statue/
\* request. The driver records the header values and either "next" or "403".
\* NoHeader represents a missing header; empty browser headers have the same
\* meaning (F4). The supplied bounds contain missing, not empty, headers.
\* The environment is fixed to ASK3D_ALLOWED_HOSTS=app.example.

Hostname(h) ==
    IF h = NoHeader THEN ""
    ELSE SubSeq(h, 1, CHOOSE n \in 0..Len(h) :
        /\ \A i \in 1..n : SubSeq(h, i, i) # ":"
        /\ IF n < Len(h) THEN SubSeq(h, n + 1, n + 1) = ":" ELSE TRUE)

\* These are exactly the LOCAL_HOSTNAME regex matches in the bounded domain.
\* This table and Hostname are abstractions restricted to the supplied hosts.
\* Accepted decisions outside these samples remain: regex-shaped IPv4 may
\* have oversized octets (F1), only [::1] is local IPv6 (F2), and .local
\* permits one preceding label (F3). They are not additional checked inputs.
LocalHost(h) ==
    Hostname(h) \in {"localhost", "192.168.1.2", "workstation.local"}

\* Exact hostname membership preserves case and ignores the request's port;
\* an allowlist entry containing a port cannot match a hostname (F6, F7).
AllowedHost(h) == LocalHost(h) \/ Hostname(h) \in AllowedHostnames

OwnOrigin(h) ==
    "http://" \o (IF h = NoHeader THEN "localhost:3000" ELSE h)

\* With no Host header, the driver uses localhost:3000 as the NextRequest
\* URL's authority for the "own" sample, while leaving Host absent.
OriginValue(h, k) ==
    CASE k = "absent" -> NoHeader
      [] k = "own" -> OwnOrigin(h)
      [] k = "other" -> "http://other.example:3000"
      [] k = "not a URL" -> "not a URL"

OriginsFor(h) == {OriginValue(h, k) : k \in OriginKinds}

\* All valid bounded origins are canonical http:// URLs; removing that
\* prefix gives exactly new URL(origin).host for these samples.
ValidOrigin(o) ==
    o \in {OwnOrigin(h) : h \in Hosts} \cup {"http://other.example:3000"}

OriginHost(o) == SubSeq(o, 8, Len(o))

FetchPermits(s) == s \in {NoHeader, "same-origin", "none"}

\* Equality uses the parsed Origin host and the complete, unchanged Host
\* header, including case and port (F5).
OriginPermits(h, o) ==
    o = NoHeader \/ (ValidOrigin(o) /\ OriginHost(o) = h)

Passes(m, h, s, o) ==
    m \in SafeMethods
    \/ (AllowedHost(h) /\ FetchPermits(s) /\ OriginPermits(h, o))

Observed == response # "unobserved"

Mutation == Observed /\ method \notin SafeMethods

TypeOK ==
    /\ method \in Methods
    /\ host \in Hosts
    /\ fetchSite \in FetchSites
    /\ origin \in OriginsFor(host)
    /\ response \in {"unobserved", "next", "403"}

SafeMethodsPass ==
    (Observed /\ method \in SafeMethods) => response = "next"

UntrustedHostsRefused ==
    (Mutation /\ ~AllowedHost(host)) => response = "403"

CrossSiteRefused ==
    (Mutation /\ ~FetchPermits(fetchSite)) => response = "403"

MalformedOriginsRefused ==
    (Mutation /\ origin # NoHeader /\ ~ValidOrigin(origin))
    => response = "403"

MismatchedOriginsRefused ==
    (Mutation /\ ValidOrigin(origin) /\ OriginHost(origin) # host)
    => response = "403"

EligibleRequestsPass ==
    (Mutation /\ AllowedHost(host) /\ FetchPermits(fetchSite)
        /\ OriginPermits(host, origin)) => response = "next"

PlainClientCanPass ==
    /\ response = "next"
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "localhost:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader
    /\ origin = NoHeader

CrossSiteCanBeRefused ==
    /\ response = "403"
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "localhost:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = "cross-site"
    /\ origin = OwnOrigin(host)

Init ==
    /\ method = "GET"
    /\ host = "localhost:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader
    /\ origin = NoHeader
    /\ response = "unobserved"

ObserveRequest(m, h, s, k) ==
    /\ method' = m
    /\ host' = h
    /\ fetchSite' = s
    /\ origin' = OriginValue(h, k)
    /\ response' = IF Passes(m, h, s, OriginValue(h, k))
        THEN "next" ELSE "403"

Next ==
    \E m \in Methods, h \in Hosts, s \in FetchSites, k \in OriginKinds :
        ObserveRequest(m, h, s, k)

\* DNS rebinding: browser headers match an attacker-controlled Host.
\* This deliberately skips the host check and violates only that rule.
BypassHostCheck ==
    /\ method' = "POST"
    /\ host' = "evil.example:3000"
    /\ fetchSite' = "same-origin"
    /\ origin' = OwnOrigin("evil.example:3000")
    /\ response' = "next"

\* A local request is incorrectly admitted despite cross-site metadata.
BypassFetchSiteCheck ==
    /\ method' = "POST"
    /\ host' = "localhost:3000"
    /\ fetchSite' = "cross-site"
    /\ origin' = OwnOrigin("localhost:3000")
    /\ response' = "next"

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
====
